description: As a small production company I want to have a structured maintenance planning system so that I can manage technical tasks efficiently

acceptance_criteria.description: Maintenance tasks are structured and documented with clear responsibilities
System provides a clear overview of upcoming maintenance activities

description: As a technical procurement department I want to coordinate spare parts requirements and delivery schedules so that I can avoid stockouts and delays

acceptance_criteria.description: Spare parts requirements are coordinated with delivery schedules
System alerts for potential delivery delays

description: As a technical service company I want to maintain technical documentation in a clear and usable structure so that I can easily access and update information

acceptance_criteria.description: Technical documentation is organized in a logical structure
Documentation is easily searchable and updatable

description: As a user I want to switch between German and English language on the website so that I can access the site in my preferred language

acceptance_criteria.description: Language switcher is visible on the website with label 'English'
Switching to English changes all website content to English
